functions.description: Read-only ownership inspection of every final output target, returning a list of conflict dicts for foreign-owned targets.

functions.name: preflight_output_targets
functions.description: Raise ConfigError if any final output target is foreign-owned, ensuring no conflicts before writing.

functions.name: preflight_output_accessibility
functions.description: Verify output_dir can actually be written before any provider is created, performing a non-destructive probe.

functions.name: _silent_remove
functions.description: Remove path if present, swallowing cleanup-time OSErrors.

functions.name: read_existing_records
functions.description: Read per-file records from a codedoc JSON output file, returning records or None if the file is missing or unreadable.

functions.name: write_project_outputs
functions.description: Write the final combined output file(s) in specified formats, ensuring ownership checks before overwriting.

functions.name: _is_codedoc_owned
functions.description: Check if path may be overwritten by codedoc, allowing non-existent or non-codedoc files.

functions.name: _foreign_file_message
functions.description: Generate a message indicating that a file cannot be overwritten because it is not a codedoc output file.

functions.name: _check_file_ownership
functions.description: Verify that *path* was written by codedoc before allowing an overwrite.

functions.name: validate_distinct_artifact_paths
functions.description: Reject two distinct generated artifacts targeting the same path.

functions.name: _filesystem_is_case_insensitive
functions.description: Detect case behavior from an existing ancestor without writing probes.

functions.name: _swap_case_letter
functions.description: Swap the case of the first letter found in the string.

files.description: This file contains function definitions for handling normalized identity values and expected analysis identities, as well as managing cache identity keys and their descriptions.
files.role_in_system: This file supports the codebase by providing essential functions for identity management, which are crucial for data integrity and analysis within the larger application framework.

functions.name: normalized_identity_value
functions.description: Return `source[key]` normalized through :data:`_CACHE_KEY_ABSENT_DEFAULTS`. An absent key resolves to its registered absent-default (or `None` when the key has no mapping).

functions.name: expected_analysis_identity
functions.description: Return the run-level cache-identity keys a freshly generated record carries. This is the part shared by every file in a run.

functions.name: expected_max_context_revision
functions.description: Return the per-file truncation cache-identity value, or `None`. It encodes the effective ceiling and head ratio for truncated files.

functions.name: expected_large_file_identity
functions.description: Return the effective-split cache-identity value, or ``None``.

functions.name: expected_ordinary_path_identity
functions.description: Return the ordinary-only path-bound cache identity for *rel_path*.

functions.name: _ordered_private_keys
functions.description: Return *registered* in canonical order.

functions.name: carry_private_keys
functions.description: Copy every registered private key present in *source* into *target*.

usage_notes.used_for: Enables compatibility with future Python versions.
Provides hashing functions for identity management.
Facilitates JSON serialization and deserialization.
